note: Fresh practice items modelled on recurring KSEAB-style grammar constructions; not copied from historical papers.

questions.prompt: The committee appreciated her ________ in completing the task. (diligent)
Ravi is ________ honest student who always speaks the truth.
The train arrived ________ the station before sunrise.
By the time we reached the hall, the programme ________. (begin)
Let us help the old man, ________?
She decided ________ the invitation. (accept)
Change into reported speech: Meena said, “I am preparing for the examination.”
questions.answer: Meena said that she was preparing for the examination.

questions.prompt: Change into passive voice: The students completed the project on time.
questions.answer: The project was completed on time by the students.

questions.prompt: Change into the positive degree: Bengaluru is one of the largest cities in Karnataka.
questions.answer: Very few cities in Karnataka are as large as Bengaluru.

questions.prompt: Frame a question to get the underlined answer: The villagers planted trees near the school.
questions.answer: Where did the villagers plant trees?

questions.prompt: If you work hard, you ________ the examination. (pass)
The road was flooded. ________, the rescue team continued its work.
Combine using ‘although’: He was tired. He continued working.
questions.answer: Although he was tired, he continued working.

questions.prompt: Rewrite in the present perfect: She finished her homework.
Neither the teacher nor the students ________ responsible for the delay. (be)
Add a suitable prefix to form the opposite of ‘regular’.
Add a suitable suffix to form a noun from ‘kind’.
Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: The child spoke **softly**.
Identify the figure of speech: The moon smiled at us through the clouds.
Correct the error: She is senior than me.
He bought ________ umbrella because it was raining heavily.
The principal congratulated the students ________ their success.
When I called her, she ________ dinner. (cook)
Nobody informed you, ________?
Change into reported speech: The teacher said to the boys, “Do not waste your time.”
questions.answer: The teacher advised the boys not to waste their time.

questions.prompt: Change into passive voice: People speak English in many countries.
questions.answer: English is spoken in many countries.

questions.prompt: Change into the comparative degree: No other metal is as useful as iron.
questions.answer: Iron is more useful than any other metal.

questions.prompt: If I had known the truth, I ________ you. (help)
He missed the bus ________ he reached the stop late.
Rewrite using ‘too...to’: The box is so heavy that I cannot lift it.
questions.answer: The box is too heavy for me to lift.

questions.prompt: Frame a question for the answer: She travelled to Mysuru by train.
questions.answer: How did she travel to Mysuru?

questions.prompt: The students look forward to ________ the science exhibition. (visit)
Each of the players ________ received a certificate. (have)
Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: We walked **across** the bridge.
Identify the figure of speech: The wind whispered through the trees.
Correct the error: He did not knew the answer.
questions.answer: He did not know the answer.

questions.prompt: Form a noun from ‘educate’.
She has been waiting ________ two hours.
The Ganga is ________ sacred river in India.
If he ________ earlier, he would not have missed the train. (leave)
Change into reported speech: Raju said, “Where are you going?”
questions.answer: Raju asked where I was going.

questions.prompt: Change into passive voice: The police caught the thief.
questions.answer: The thief was caught by the police.

questions.prompt: Study well, ________ you may not perform well in the examination.
Rewrite using ‘unless’: You will not succeed if you do not work hard.
questions.answer: You will not succeed unless you work hard.

questions.prompt: I am late, ________?
Change into the superlative degree: Very few flowers are as beautiful as the rose.
questions.answer: The rose is one of the most beautiful flowers.

questions.prompt: Rewrite in the past perfect: They complete the work before the manager arrives.
questions.answer: They had completed the work before the manager arrived.

questions.prompt: Correct the error: She prefers tea than coffee.
His ________ impressed everyone. (honest)
